question: records
reviewed_by: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-09; every quote checked against open-us-law v2026.09.1

facts.process_name: Request public records from a Virginia public body
facts.trigger: A person asks a public body for its public records

trigger_source.quote: all public records shall be open to citizens of the Commonwealth

source.quote: The custodian may require the requester to provide his name and legal address.
Any public body that is subject to this chapter and that is the custodian of the requested records
Any public body may petition the appropriate court for additional time to respond to a request for records
A request for public records shall identify the requested records with reasonable specificity.
Prior to conducting a search for records, the public body shall notify the requester in writing that the public body may make reasonable charges

Any public body may petition the appropriate court for additional time to respond to a request for records when the request is for an extraordinary volume of records or requires an extraordinarily lengthy search

steps.action: Provide records or answer in writing

source.quote: promptly, but in all cases within five working days of receiving a request
provide the requested records to the requester or make one of the following responses in writing

deadline.anchor: the end of the five-work-day period

source.quote: the public body shall have an additional seven work days
It is not practically possible to provide the requested records or to determine whether they are available within the five-work-day period.

steps.action: Supply records at lowest possible cost

source.quote: shall make all reasonable efforts to supply the requested records at the lowest possible cost

decisions.question: Which written response does the public body give?

inputs.name: practical
inputs.label: Possible to answer within five work days

inputs.name: records_exist
inputs.label: Records exist and can be found

then: "Not practically possible: seven more work days"

source.quote: Such response shall specify the conditions that make a response impossible.

then: "Records could not be found or do not exist"

source.quote: The requested records could not be found or do not exist.
The requested records are being entirely withheld.

then: "Provided in part and withheld in part"

source.quote: The requested records are being provided in part and are being withheld in part.
provide the requested records to the requester

outcomes.description: One of the four responses given within the extension

source.quote: in which to provide one of the four preceding responses
Access to such records shall be provided by the custodian in accordance with this chapter by inspection or by providing copies of the requested records, at the option of the requester.

cross_references.role: criminal investigative files get 60 work days instead of seven

source.quote: in the case of a request for criminal investigative files pursuant to § 2.2-3706.1 , 60 work days

cross_references.role: Virginia Public Records Act; records archived at the Library of Virginia

source.quote: Virginia Public Records Act (§ 42.1-76 et seq.)

gaps: Failure to respond within the time limits is deemed a denial (subsection E); the model ends the request there, and enforcement by petition for mandamus or injunction under Va. Code § 2.2-3713 is not modelled.

The cost-estimate exchange in subsection F (30 days to answer an estimate, or the request is deemed withdrawn) and the deposit for charges over $200 in subsection H are not modelled as separate steps.
